title: Citation-grounded research report
description: After automine, a planner / researcher / reporter / validator drafts a report from pipeline findings only. Citations must resolve to RelOp pairs, catalog accessions, or bound KPI rows. The SLM never writes SQL and never invents papers. Identification is none.

agents.role: Turn the automine handoff into a section plan. Do not add candidates that are not in the handoff.
Collect citation cards from live RelOp pairs, spec/domain-*.json accessions, and bound KPI rows. No web invention.
Draft section markdown. Cite only provided [E#] cards. Local SLM or cloud API if present; otherwise a deterministic draft.
Strip unknown citation ids, keep honesty banner, refuse conclusive-proof language. Discard SLM text that cites a missing source.

honesty: Possible etiology evidence from bound RelOp pairs, catalogued accessions, and KPI rows. Identification is none. Not conclusive proof, not a discovery claim, not medical advice.
